posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you failed to understand the battle sequence.
skill selection and skill execution are two different parts of the sequence, and the troop events are always processed on skill execution, never on skill selection.
that said, nothing in there should stop the player from selecting commands or using items in the selection phase. so if that is skipped, then something else is interfering as well.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
as I already said, the selection phase is outside the scope of the events - you CANNOT have an event run or trigger on selection.
what you can do is have a troop event on turn 0 (before everything) give instructions and apply a state that seals unwanted skills, then have the player make the selection for turn 1, and then run an event on the execution of turn 1 that sets different state for the turn 2 selection and so on.
as such your second troop event is useless because it doesn't do anything at all.
And sealing skills by state is a much better way than removing them with the change skill command for a lot of reasons. For example removing attack and/or guard is useless because the two buttons are hardcoded overrides that are always available.
And some battle plugins do not update the battlers on changes to the actor data, so it is not clear if those commands even take effect. The states however will work in battle.
you just need to make the states sealing the skills to have a duration of 2 because the first turn is the current turn, and they need to be there for effects on the selection phase of the next turn.
But again, you need to find out why the selection phase is skipped because the troop events above cannot do this.

First thing to do is change the order of your plugins. The Yanfly plugins should be in the order listed here:
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Yanfly_Engine_Plugins
And for testing purposes, you can just turn all your plugins off and see if things work as expected. If they do, you'll know it's a plugin causing your issues and can work on narrowing down which one.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
As I already mentioned above the yanfly plugins can cause strange errors if installed in the wrong order - and your order of them is a mess. Please follow the advice of the poster above to re-sort them.
Please be aware that resorting them will make all previous saves incompatible, you'll have to start a new playtest after that.
Another question: which troop did you define as the base troop for the base troop events?
and which events are in that troop?
Because if I had known that you use that plugin, I would have asked for that info long ago as it could cause such problems as well if there are conflicting troop events.
